title: Quality gate thresholds
description: Repository-owned thresholds for the COMPLEXITY, MUTATION, and DEPENDENCY_RULES gate slots, skips for any slot, and the opt-in slots the repository runs, kept at .specify/quality-gates.json. The operator writes it through the speckit-coach quality-gates flow; agents never edit it. Enforced locally by speckit_pro_runner/quality_gates.py (standard library); this file documents the same rules.

complexity.description: Maximum cyclomatic complexity per changed function.

crap.description: Maximum CRAP score per changed function.

mutation_score_floor.description: Minimum mutation score, percent. The survival ceiling passed to the tool is 100 minus this.

skips.description: Permanent repository-wide skips, one per slot. A skipped slot is N/A in every workflow without asking.

recorded.description: Date the operator recorded the skip.

enforce.description: Opt-in slots this repository runs. A listed slot runs and blocks; an opt-in slot not listed here never runs.
